falsifiers: Any mixed-value ZOE class rejects transfer on that carrier.
Full multiplicity must remain Q-V exact on every case or the current component carrier itself is invalid there.
A pass on 3x7-k3 is only a control because that geometry was already affine-scalar-consistent under earlier coordinates.
